parsed.rationale: V1–V3 show rS/QS complexes with poor R-wave progression and about 2–3 mm of ST elevation with upright T waves, and the rhythm is regular with no LBBB or LVH voltage pattern; lead I and aVL are noisy, so this rests mainly on the precordial leads.
